description: Model fallback chains for agent self-healing. When a model is unhealthy, agents are switched to the next healthy model in the chain.

healerConfig.label: Zo Fast (built-in, no external dependency)
healerConfig.rule: The healer agent MUST run on a Zo-native model (zo:fast or zo:smart) that has no external provider dependency. Never add zo:fast or zo:smart to a fallback chain.

probeConfig.prompt: You are a health check responder. List the numbers 1 through 10, each on its own line. After the list, write exactly: HEALTH_CHECK_PASS
